opening.argument: The video presents a step-by-step guide to configuring Cardano payments in a WooCommerce store. It shows the payment settings with Test Mode active, then a checkout with a Cardano selection, an ADA amount, manual transfer controls, and a QR code under a test-mode notice. A VESPR Wallet approval screen also appears during the demonstration. These are concrete configuration and checkout examples, not evidence that a payment was completed. The available video evidence does not establish a completed transaction, a loss, or a harmful outcome. Taken together, the tutorial framing and visibly marked test mode support reading the wallet and checkout activity as an operational demonstration.

citations.quote: Learn how to accept Cardano (ADA) payments in WooCommerce with this complete step-by-step tutorial
